declared overlay:true, and its plots are ABSOLUTE Bitcoin price bands: median |value| 370956 against a price median of 116 on fixture A, and off the price neighbourhood on fixture B at 4200 as well. Correct for BTC, catastrophic for anything else — and a generic catalogue offers it against whatever instrument the workspace is showing. Repositioning it to its own pane would draw the bands correctly and still say nothing about the instrument on screen, so it is excluded rather than moved

declared overlay:true; five plots sit on the price scale and `osc` ("Oscillator") has a median |value| of 0.35 against a price median of 116, on both fixtures. One entry carrying two scales has no single correct `placement`: over-price renders the oscillator off-axis and own-pane renders the five moving averages off-axis. Excluded rather than repositioned, because either choice draws something wrong

declares plot0 "T3" and plot1 "T3fibo", and the result carries only plot0 unless `showFibo` is true, which defaults to false. The manifest cannot promise plot1. Reducing the promise to plot0 was measured and rejected: `showFibo`, `lengthFibo` and `volumeFactorFibo` would then be three offered controls whose only effect is a plot the manifest does not draw, and holding them back would need a ledger of a third kind — they are not inert, so the inert ledger would become a lie about them. Excluding the one entry costs less than inventing that ledger
